samples.usedPrompt:
以提供的最终成品为唯一视觉基准，制作同尺寸比例4:5的完整无字底图。不是重新创作，不重排图层，不改变任何物体的大小、位置、角度、透视、材质、透明度、亮暗、反射或遮挡关系。
只清除：左上角独立品牌字标；右上角小文字；上方大标题；标题下简介；下方互动卡中的标签文字和问题文字；最底部slogan文字。对清除区域按原背景或卡面自然补全，不形成色块。保留所有分隔线、完整互动卡及其毛玻璃透明/模糊/渐变效果、橙色无字胶囊和底部横线。
严格保留：黑灰安静背景与非常淡的曲面纹理、原片的遮罩与渐变、底部物体逐渐融入暗底的效果、玻璃的真实透明度、银色拉丝金属、橙色材质。机器人保留原球形白壳、黑色椭圆面罩、双白色眼、天线、手臂及胸前原标记；不要扩大或移动它，不重新画另一个角色。
不能增强背景纹理对比度，不能新增光带、发光特效、独立几何纹样或道具。不生成任何新的标题、简介、页脚或品牌字标。

samples.usedPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Input image 1 is the canonical character reference: preserve its single round white satin shell, black oval glass visor, two matching softly luminous white oval eyes, short tapered flipper arms connected by orange circular hinges, thin orange antenna with a small white sphere, and existing chest surface marking. Input image 2 is only a composition reference for robot with small icon cards; do not copy its light streaks, three-card count, brand lettering or extra decorative effects.
Create a complete 16:9 high quality physically rendered tutorial poster BASE with no publishing text. Graphite-black quiet studio background with a subtle wide soft gradient and minimal real ground shadow. Robot fills about 35% of image height, at x73% y48%, whole silhouette including antenna and both arms visible. Gentle 10-degree tilt toward the cards. One arm clearly introduces the lower-left card, connected through the original hinge; other arm relaxed naturally. Keep the exact canonical body proportions and eye spacing, no stretched head or separate neck, no fingers, no extra limbs.
EXACTLY TWO small rounded square charcoal icon cards near the robot, secondary in scale: one simple raised white percent (%) icon with a tiny orange accent at x58% y35%; one raised clock icon with white dial and orange hand at x59% y65%. Each card at most 11% of full image width, shallow premium beveled edges, slight different natural perspective, never covering the robot's face. These two icons visibly relate to calculation rate and settlement time. No written labels or numbers. Cards are modest accents, not a ring, no connected lines, no orbit, no extraneous props or calculator.
Reserve left x6–47% entirely for future title/copy, top-left for an official logo, bottom-left for a small slogan. Keep this region dark, quiet and readable. Main cluster entirely in x52–94%, y15–83% with balanced scale and useful negative space.
Palette: satin white, graphite charcoal, controlled orange #FF8200 key parts, narrow brushed silver rim only. Same physical material/lighting language as reference: broad top-left softbox, clear visor reflections that do not hide eyes, soft neutral fill, natural contact shading. No neon, no orange light ribbons, particles, lens flare, halo, starbursts, background patterns or excessive bloom. No new text, logo, slogan, watermark. All publishing typography and official standalone logo are added afterward.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Input image 1 is the canonical character reference: preserve its single round white satin shell, black oval glass visor, two matching softly luminous white oval eyes, short tapered flipper arms connected by orange circular hinges, thin orange antenna with a small white sphere, and existing chest surface marking. Input image 2 is only a composition reference for robot with small icon cards; do not copy its light streaks, three-card count, brand lettering or extra decorative effects.
Create a complete 16:9 high quality physically rendered tutorial poster BASE with no publishing text. Graphite-black quiet studio background with a subtle wide soft gradient and minimal real ground shadow. Robot fills about 35% of image height, at x73% y48%, whole silhouette including antenna and both arms visible. Gentle 10-degree tilt toward the cards. One arm clearly introduces the lower-left card, connected through the original hinge; other arm relaxed naturally. Keep the exact canonical body proportions and eye spacing, no stretched head or separate neck, no fingers, no extra limbs.
EXACTLY TWO small rounded square charcoal icon cards near the robot, secondary in scale: one simple raised white percent (%) icon with a tiny orange accent at x58% y35%; one raised clock icon with white dial and orange hand at x59% y65%. Each card at most 11% of full image width, shallow premium beveled edges, slight different natural perspective, never covering the robot's face. These two icons visibly relate to calculation rate and settlement time. No written labels or numbers. Cards are modest accents, not a ring, no connected lines, no orbit, no extraneous props or calculator.
Reserve left x6–47% entirely for future title/copy, top-left for an official logo, bottom-left for a small slogan. Keep this region dark, quiet and readable. Main cluster entirely in x52–94%, y15–83% with balanced scale and useful negative space.
Palette: satin white, graphite charcoal, controlled orange #FF8200 key parts, narrow brushed silver rim only. Same physical material/lighting language as reference: broad top-left softbox, clear visor reflections that do not hide eyes, soft neutral fill, natural contact shading. No neon, no orange light ribbons, particles, lens flare, halo, starbursts, background patterns or excessive bloom. No new text, logo, slogan, watermark. materialRule: 材质统一：新生成的产品海报使用光滑镀银、哑光烤漆与黑玻璃，不使用拉丝金属、滚花、磨砂颗粒或斑驳纹理。地面必须为光滑、无纹理的深灰或近黑平面，只保留柔和接触阴影与克制反射；纸张、人物和室内原有材质按实际参考保留。
actionRule: 机器人可观察、示意或斜向飞行；肩部保持短小自然连接，翼臂按动作有限展开，与道具留间隙，不夹持、搭压或承重，不增肢体。动态用前后景尺度差、斜向排列、10–15°机身倾斜、悬浮高度与视线体现，不站成一排。静态只真实光照；飞行可用一道随运动方向的短橙色拖影与轻微背景速度模糊，角色、眼睛和胸标清晰，不加粒子或多道光带。
